title: Prior N(100, 10²) and data mean 110
caption: The prior has precision 1/100 and the data 4/100, so the posterior has precision 0.05, variance 20 (SD ≈ 4.47) and mean (100 × 0.01 + 110 × 0.04)/0.05 = 108: pulled most of the way to the data.
alt: Three normal curves: a broad prior centred at 100, the likelihood of the sample mean centred at 110 with SD 5, and a taller posterior between them at 108.
description: Prior N(100, 100); data mean 110 has variance 100/4 = 25.
Precisions add: 0.01 + 0.04 = 0.05, so the posterior variance is 20.
The posterior mean is the precision-weighted average, 108.
